title: I think a lot of things will bug you if you buy this
text:
I think a lot of things will bug you if you buy this. I had the previous model of this bissell and was excited to use this new model. I am a little bummed out at how the unit works though. Assembly was easy. Instructions were simple to follow. But:
• I noticed right off the bat, the removable, washable filters are in a separate canister found under the holding container (where the dirt goes)and can only be accessed if you pop off the holding container. Then, you must once again, pop off an additional top to get to the round spongy filter so you can wash it. Total extra step.
•Then, there is no more retractable cord. You must manually wrap the cord round the machine. Only, look at attached pic in my review. There is not enough room for the cord. I had to shove the cord in "just so" to make it fit. It does hang off to the left. In my opinion, this is preferred, because I hold the cord with left hand while I vacuum.
•Next, the unit is HEAVY and clunky. I am a fit middle aged woman and had a hard time getting vacuum to lift over the edge of my area rugs. I had to manhandle the unit over. It did not glide smoothly. Because of it's weight, this may be a problem for you to handle comfortable.
•My biggest irritation of this thing is that the base swivels. You know how it feels when the handle of a mop or vacuum hasn't been secured correctly to the base? You over compensate your movement up top for the wiggling at the base. This has that exact same sensation. And it's inessential to the workings of ANY vacuum.
Totally not needed imo.
•also not needed, the "reduced suction" option found on the hose (see picture). Initially it was set to that and I didn't know. I went over my rug 10 or 15 times and nothing came up. I looked thru instructions and found nothing pointing it out. It took my scouring over vacuum for a good while trying to assess what was wrong. I finally found the option and turned it to "full suck"
The suction is o.k. Not the strongest. Nor the weakest of vacuums I've used. The vacuum self-propelled but, because of it's weight, your arm still fatigues.
•there are no side bristles sticking off the vacuum base to help with floorboard and edge dust.
•the detachable hose has a massive handle on it that is clumsy and sticks out when you try and store it.
Over-all, I feel like they tried to add too much to this. Collectively all these extra things just don't work. Do the 1 thing great.
Make a vacuum that "sucks" , whose filter can be quickly accessed and washed. Make the cord stow away correctly, make the extension hose easy to get off and on and the extension tools easy to store. Too much to ask? On this unit, yes!

product_metadata.title: Bissell, 2043U Cleanview Lift Off Pet Upright Bagless Vacuum
features: 2-in-1 vacuum with Lift-Off Technology for stairs, upholstery and more.
ON/OFF brush roll switch with triple action brush roll maximizes cleaning across multiple surfaces including carpet, rugs, hardwood floors, laminate, tile, and vinyl.
Specialized pet tools remove pet hair from stairs, upholstery and other hard-to-reach areas where pet hair collects.
Bonus Pet Hair Fabric Tool removes embedded pet hair from upholstery and other surfaces.
Smart Seal Allergen System helps trap dust, dander, and allergens inside the vacuum.
Febreze Pet Odor Eliminator Filter eliminates pet odors and freshens as you vacuum.
description: The BISSELL Clean View Lift-Off Pet Vacuum is a 2-in-1 vacuum with Lift-Off Technology that allows it to clean where other vacuums can't. You also get the powerful clean of a full-size upright vacuum and the convenient cleaning of an easy-release portable vacuum. The on-board, ready to use tools make it easy to clean stairs, furniture, upholstery, and other areas where pet hair collects. The Smart Seal Allergen System helps keep dust, dander and allergens inside the vacuum while the optional Febreze filter eliminates pet odors and freshens while you vacuum. When you purchase a BISSELL Clean View Lift-Off Pet Vacuum you help save pets. BISSELL will donate $10 to the BISSELL Pet Foundation for each pet product sold. This year we're committed to donating at least $1, 000, 000 to BISSELL Pet Foundation. BISSELL is proud to design products that help make pet stains, odors, and pet homelessness disappear.
